title: ISO 230-2:2014 — Test code for machine tools — Part 2: Determination of accuracy and repeatability of positioning of numerically controlled axes
locator: Official catalogue abstract and scope: direct measurement of individual NC linear and rotary axes, positioning accuracy and repeatability; current version confirmed in 2025
notes: This is a machine-axis positioning test method and applies equally to linear and rotary axes. It is not a substitute for gear component inspection, rotary-axis error-motion testing under ISO 230-7, thermal testing under ISO 230-3 or multi-axis interpolation testing. Full text is not archived.
